title: Subscription to the International Development Association
what_it_is: Subscription to the International Development Association

sections.label: IDA20 replenishment brought forward
sections.summary: IDA20 was moved from FY2024-FY2026 to FY2023-FY2025, and donors supported a US$93 billion replenishment in December 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The 20th IDA Replenishment (IDA20), originally covering the period FY2024 to FY2026, had to be brought forward by a year to cover FY2023 to FY2025 as almost half of the IDA19 replenishment of US$82 billion was committed in FY2021 to provide urgent financial resources to support IDA countries that were badly affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In December 2021, IDA donors therefore supported a historic replenishment of US$93 billion for IDA20.

sections.label: Singapore contribution share IDA20
sections.summary: The Motion proposes maintaining Singapore's contribution share of 0.20% to the larger IDA20 envelope.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: For this Motion, we therefore propose to maintain our contribution share of 0.20% to this larger IDA20 envelope.

sections.label: Southeast Asia pandemic economic impact
sections.summary: The Asian Development Bank estimates Southeast Asia's growth fell by close to one percentage point and 4.7 million more people were pushed into poverty.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: In Southeast Asia alone, the Asian Development Bank estimates that the region's economic growth was dampened by close to one percentage point and 4.7 million more people were pushed into poverty.

sections.label: Development fund for foreign aid agency
sections.summary: Setting aside IMF and IDA subscriptions plus a modest official development assistance budget into a development fund could seed a foreign aid agency called SingAid.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: One approach that can help seed the initial formation of a foreign aid agency is to set aside IMF and IDA subscriptions, along with a very modest budget for official development assistance into a development fund.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: This fund can then be managed directly by a foreign aid agency – call it Singapore's Assistance for International Development or SingAid.

sections.label: Aid conditions and SingAid focus
sections.summary: Aid is best when conditional on good policy, and the proposed SingAid should focus on foreign assistance with win-win economic outcomes.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Aid tends to be best delivered when conditional on good policy and we have an abundance of technical knowledge in this area, having gone through our own development journey in exceedingly rapid fashion.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: While neutrality is not formally enshrined as a foreign policy doctrine, we have pursued a pro neutral approach since our Independence and our emphasis on fundamental bedrock principles such as respect for sovereignty and the rule of law, along with the pursuit of mutual interest, is aligned with this.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: If anything, what I am suggesting is that the proposed SingAid focus on providing foreign assistance with an eye on win-win economic outcomes.

sections.label: Singapore contributions to institutions and relief
sections.summary: Singapore contributes to the World Bank Group, Asian Development Bank, Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and IMF, and gave humanitarian and COVAX AMC assistance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Apart from the contributions to the World Bank Group, we also contribute to institutions like the Asian Development Bank, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the International Monetary Fund.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Last year, Singapore contributed humanitarian assistance to Ukraine as well as to the disaster relief and humanitarian efforts following the earthquake in West Java, Indonesia.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: And during the pandemic, Singapore contributed to the COVID-19 Vaccine Global Access Advance Market Commitment, or COVAX AMC, which helps support access to vaccines for over 90 low- and middle-income countries.

sections.label: Singapore Cooperation Programme training
sections.summary: Singapore has provided training for close to 150,000 foreign officials under the Singapore Cooperation Programme since it started 30 years ago.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Beyond mandatory contributions, we have also contributed our technical know-how, providing training for close to 150,000 foreign officials under the Singapore Cooperation Programme since it started 30 years ago.
